summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his lecture on prayer timings from Kitab as-Salah in al-Wajiz, focusing on the timing of Zuhr prayer during hot weather. He discusses two narrations: one from Jabir ibn Samura indicating the Prophet would pray Zuhr early, and one from Abu Hurairah showing the Prophet would delay Zuhr until it cooled down. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains that the timing depends on the heat intensity—when extreme heat occurs, it is Sunnah to delay prayer to ensure comfort for worshippers, particularly those who walk to the masjid. This principle extends to other extreme weather conditions and is based on the hadith that daytime heat is from the intensity of Jahannam.
